source_section: Part 1: The Primordial Forces > Entry 1.1: The Root Shal- (Light)
meaning_or_function: Light, glow, brightness; hope, truth, creation, clarity, revelation, wisdom, life, beginnings.
derived_forms: Shal + Lian = Revelation; Shal + Rin = Aura / Pure Essence; Shal + Thar = Hope / Courage
original_wording: Literal Meaning: Light, glow, brightness. Positive Connotations: Hope, truth (Lian), creation, clarity, revelation, wisdom, life, beginnings.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; does not replace existing Shal lexicon rows.

source_section: Part 1: The Primordial Forces > Entry 1.2: The Root Fah- / Vethor- (Darkness/ Shadow)
meaning_or_function: Fah: total darkness, the void, fear. Vethor: shadow, mystery, shade, gentler natural darkness.
derived_forms: Vethor + Lian = A Hidden Truth / A Secret; Fah + Thar = Despair / Sorrow; Rath + Vethor = A Hidden Enemy / Ambusher
original_wording: Fah: Total darkness, the void, fear. Vethor: Shadow, mystery, shade, a gentler, more natural darkness.
notes: Root pair preserved as source presents it; existing Fah and Vethor entries remain separate.

source_section: Part 2: The Elemental Pillars > Entry 2.1: The Root Krez- (Fire)
meaning_or_function: Fire, heat, energy; passion, creation, strength, life-force, warmth, resilience, purification.
derived_forms: Krez + Thal = Dynamic Equilibrium; Krez + Lian = A Harsh Truth; Krez + Vok = A Forge / A Crucible
original_wording: Literal Meaning: Fire, Heat, Energy. Positive Connotations: Passion, creation, strength (Kal), life-force, warmth, resilience, purification (Krezmorath ritual).
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; Krezthal/Krezathal variation already flagged in euphony supplement.

source_section: Part 2: The Elemental Pillars > Entry 2.2: The Root Dren- (Water)
meaning_or_function: Water, liquid, fluid; life, flow, change, healing, emotion, intuition, cleansing, adaptation.
derived_forms: Dren + Thal = Harmony / Serenity; Dren + Shara = A Meandering Path / A Destiny of Change; Dren + Rin = Blood / Life-Essence
original_wording: Dren is the primary metaphor for the flow of emotion, life, and connection.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; no standalone lexicon rows created for pairings.

source_section: Part 2: The Elemental Pillars > Entry 2.3: The Root Morl- (Stone/Mountain)
meaning_or_function: Stone, rock, mountain; endurance, history, stubbornness, strength, foundation, stability, defense.
derived_forms: Morl + Thar = A Resolute Heart / Stoicism; Morl + Lian = A Foundational Truth / A Dogma; Morl + Karash = Stone-Without-Vision
original_wording: Morl is the ultimate metaphor for the past and for things that are unchanging.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; links to euphony Morlathar and existing Morl lexicon rows.

source_section: Part 2: The Elemental Pillars > Entry 2.4: The Root Esh- (Sky/Air)
meaning_or_function: Sky, air, wind; freedom, thought, divine, intellect, perspective, beginnings.
derived_forms: Esh + Thal = Clarity of Mind / Perspective; Esh + Shara = A Sky-Path / A Celestial Journey; Esh + Lianor = An Epiphany / A Divine Thought
original_wording: Esh is the primary metaphor for the mind and for abstract thought.

source_section: Part 2: The Elemental Pillars > Entry 2.5: The Root terra- / Terra- (earth)
meaning_or_function: Earth, ground, soil, land; lowercase terra is mundane physical ground; capitalized Terra is the world as living spiritual entity.
derived_forms: Terra + Dren = Fertile Soil / The Source of Life; Terra + Rin = World-Soul / The Spirit of Ohnosha; Terra + Bel = A Foundation / A Grounding Principle
original_wording: Capitalized Terra refers to the planet as a living, spiritual entity, the "Heart of Terra."
notes: Current naming applied: Ohnosha is the current world name; Terra is the Celan world/sacred term; terra is physical land/ground.

source_section: Part 3: The Metaphysical Concepts > Entry 3.1: The Root Lian- (Truth)
meaning_or_function: Truth, honesty; reality, natural law, essence, logic, clarity, correctness.
derived_forms: Lian + Thal = Justice / Fairness; Lian + Bel = A Vow / An Oath; Ver + Lian = A Lie / Untruth
original_wording: Lian is not just something you speak; it is a state of being.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; links to lianeth modality through existing Volume 4 material.

source_section: Part 3: The Metaphysical Concepts > Entry 3.2: The Root Thal- (Balance)
meaning_or_function: Balance, harmony, equilibrium; also preposition meaning From / Out of.
derived_forms: Thal + Rin = Destiny / The Natural Order; Thal + Vok = A Perfect Bond / Harmony; absence of Thal defines Rethvok
original_wording: As a Noun: Thal is an active, dynamic state, not a passive one.
notes: Source uses Ohnoshan worldview language; current naming applied.

source_section: Part 3: The Metaphysical Concepts > Entry 3.3: The Root Reth- / Rethvok- (Uncertainty/Chaos)
meaning_or_function: Reth: uncertainty, confusion, doubt, a question, or. Rethvok: chaos, disorder, un-ordered state.
derived_forms: Rethvok + Shara = A Path of Ruin / A Bad Decision; Reth + Lianor = A Paradox / A Riddle
original_wording: The conjunction "Or" (reth) is derived from this root, implying that the act of having to choose between options is an inherent state of uncertainty.
notes: Refines existing Reth conjunction and Rethvok chaos rows; no resolution applied.

source_section: Part 3: The Metaphysical Concepts > Entry 3.4: The Root Nor- (Time/Flow)
meaning_or_function: Time, the flow of events; also future prefix and preposition at/in time.
derived_forms: Nor + Vel = Continuity / Eternity; Nor + Ka = Now / This moment; nor-ka Echo Particle
original_wording: Time is often conceptualized as a river. One can be swept along by it, or one can learn to navigate its currents.
notes: Refines existing Nor future/preposition/passive overlaps; no resolution applied.

source_section: Part 3: The Metaphysical Concepts > Entry 3.5: The Root Rin- (Essence)
meaning_or_function: Essence, core nature, spirit, intrinsic quality.
derived_forms: Rin + Thal = Integrity; Ver + Rin = Soulless / Fake / Artificial
original_wording: Every object, person, and concept is believed to have a Rin. It is their unchanging, true self, distinct from their physical form.
notes: Important identity-context refinement preserved; no existing identity entries changed.

source_section: Part 4: The Social & Personal Concepts > Entry 4.1: The Root Bel- (To bind/Weave)
meaning_or_function: To bind, weave, connect, fasten; civilization, bonds, restrictions, systems.
derived_forms: Bel + Thal = Order / The System / The Great Weave; Bel + Shara = Duty / A Bound Path; Bel + Vok = Clan / Family
original_wording: Bel is the fundamental principle of civilization.

source_section: Part 4: The Social & Personal Concepts > Entry 4.2: The Root Kal- (Strength)
meaning_or_function: Strength, power, force; neutral force whose virtue depends on use.
derived_forms: Kal + -or = Spiritual Strength / Willpower; Kal + Varok = Dominion / Tyranny; Kal + Rin = The Essence of Strength
original_wording: Kal is a neutral force. It is not inherently good or bad. Its virtue is determined by how it is used.
notes: Source uses Ohnoshan language for philosophical debate; current naming applied.

source_section: Part 4: The Social & Personal Concepts > Entry 4.3: The Root Shara- (Path)
meaning_or_function: A path, a road, a journey; life path, strategy, decision path.
derived_forms: Shara + -ka = Freedom; Shara + Thal = An Outcome / A Result; Lian + Shara = The True Path / Righteousness
original_wording: One's life is universally seen as a Shara.

source_section: Part 4: The Social & Personal Concepts > Entry 4.4: The Root Ohm- (Connection/Unity)
meaning_or_function: Connection, meeting point, circuit; spiritual connection distinct from Bel.
derived_forms: Ohm + -aen = To Love / To Cherish / To Attune With; Ohm + Rin = Attunement / Empathy; Ohm + Vok = The Collective Consciousness / The Great Bond
original_wording: Ohm is the principle that no person or thing is an island.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; Bel/Ohm distinction flagged because it affects interpretation.

source_section: Part 4: The Social & Personal Concepts > Entry 4.5: The Root Thar- (Heart)
meaning_or_function: The physical heart; source of emotion, will, and true inner self.
derived_forms: Thar + -ka = Desire / Will; Thar + Lian = An Oath / A Heart-Truth; Morl + Thar = Stoicism / A Resolute Heart
original_wording: The mind (Lianor) thinks, but the heart (Thar) is.
notes: Source uses Ohnoshan stories language; current naming applied.

source_section: Part 5: The Concepts of Action & Being > Entry 5.1: The Root Var- (To Go/Move)
meaning_or_function: To go, move, travel; also preposition to/towards; action and existence.
derived_forms: Var + Ok = To Command / To Direct; Ver + Var = Stasis / Inaction
original_wording: In Celan, "to be" is often expressed as an act of "going" or "moving."
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; links to existing Var verb/preposition rows.

source_section: Part 5: The Concepts of Action & Being > Entry 5.2: The Root Aen- (To Speak/Breathe)
meaning_or_function: To speak, breathe, make a sound; also complementizer that.
derived_forms: Aen + -or = The Ear / Place of Sound; Aen + Nor = Music
original_wording: Speech and breath are considered two sides of the same life-giving coin.
notes: Refines Aen/Aenor polysemy and complementizer usage; no resolution applied.

source_section: Part 5: The Concepts of Action & Being > Entry 5.3: The Root Pralaen- (To Make/Craft)
meaning_or_function: To make, craft, shape with care; skill, purpose, imposing order.
derived_forms: Pralaen + Shal = To Create Fate; Pralaen + Rethvok = To cause destruction / To make a mess
original_wording: Pralaen is distinct from simple "creation." It implies skill, purpose, and the act of imposing order (Belthal).

source_section: Part 5: The Concepts of Action & Being > Entry 5.4: The Root Rav- (To Pull/Yearn)
meaning_or_function: To pull, draw towards; desire, deep yearning, destiny pull.
derived_forms: Rav- + -okhaen = To Desire / To Yearn For; Rav- + Thar = A Yearning Heart / Passionate Longing
original_wording: Rav- is the root of desire. It represents the gravitational pull of the heart (Thar) or spirit towards a person, object, or goal.

source_section: Part 5: The Concepts of Action & Being > Entry 5.5: The Root Vok- (To Break/Unite)
meaning_or_function: Duality of breaking a bond and forming a unity; noun Vok means unity; verb vokaen breaks unity.
derived_forms: Vok + -aen = To Betray / To Break a Bond; Bel + Vok = Clan / Family; Reth + Vok = Chaos
original_wording: This root embodies a profound duality. The noun Vok means "Unity." The primary verb vokaen means "to break that unity."
notes: Refines Vok unity/betrayal polysemy; no merge or correction applied.

source_section: Part 6: The Concepts of Society & Culture > Entry 6.1: The Root Ser- (Friend/With)
meaning_or_function: Friend, ally; also with and and.
derived_forms: Ser + Rin = Friendship / Comradery; Kal + Ser = An Ally of Strength / A Bodyguard
original_wording: To connect two things with "and" (ser) is to place them in accompaniment (ser), which is the very essence of being a friend (Ser).
notes: Refines existing Ser friend/with/and polysemy; no resolution applied.

source_section: Part 6: The Concepts of Society & Culture > Entry 6.2: The Root Rath- (Enemy/If)
meaning_or_function: Enemy, foe, adversary; also conditional particle if.
derived_forms: Rath + -or = Enemy Territory / A Place of Great Danger; Rath + Vethor = A Hidden Enemy / An Assassin; Rath + Thar = A Hateful Heart / Malevolence
original_wording: The conditional "if" (rath) is derived from the word for "enemy."
notes: Refines Rath conditional/foe relation; no resolution applied.

source_section: Part 6: The Concepts of Society & Culture > Entry 6.3: The Root Khum- (To Listen/Know)
meaning_or_function: To listen, perceive, know through hearing; patient knowing and introspection.
derived_forms: Khum- + -rel = To Listen Deeply / To Meditate On; Khum- + -lor = A Circle / A Council
original_wording: Khum- implies a deeper, more patient form of knowing than the visual Shalaen (to see).

source_section: Part 6: The Concepts of Society & Culture > Entry 6.4: The Root Zhir- (Thread/Lineage)
meaning_or_function: Thread, line, cord; connection through time, lineage, history, cause-effect, fate.
derived_forms: Ka + Zhir = Without Lineage / Bastard; Zhir + Vok = A Severed Tie / A Betrayal of Heritage
original_wording: Zhir- is the primary metaphor for connection through time. This is distinct from Bel (social binding) and Ohm (spiritual connection).
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; Bel/Ohm/Zhir distinctions flagged because they affect interpretation.

source_section: Part 6: The Concepts of Society & Culture > Entry 6.5: The Root Kel- (To Say/Name)
meaning_or_function: To say, speak, name; definition and ordering through language.
derived_forms: Kel- + -ka = A Word; Kel- + Rin = A Name; Kel- + Ver = Silence
original_wording: Kel- is distinct from the life-giving Aen (to speak/breathe). Kel- is the intellectual, ordering act of defining reality through language.
notes: Conceptual layer preserved; Aen/Kel distinction flagged because it affects lookup and interpretation.
